name: MD Residential Lease
description: Single family residential lease (Maryland). Dates, amounts in words, term, prorated rent, total rent and late charge fill themselves in.
body:
SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENTIAL LEASE

THIS LEASE is made this {{lease_day}} day of {{lease_month}}, {{lease_year}} by and between {{landlord_name}} (hereinafter referred to as the "Landlord") and {{tenant_name}} (hereinafter referred to as the "Tenant").

SECTION I - PROPERTY RENT

Landlord does hereby rent to Tenant, and Tenant does hereby lease from Landlord, the premises known as {{premises_address}} (hereinafter referred to as the "Premises"), for the term of {{term_words}} ({{term_number}}) months beginning on the {{start_day}} day of {{start_month}}, {{start_year}}, and ending on the {{end_day}} day of {{end_month}}, {{end_year}}, for the sum of {{total_rent_words}} (${{total_rent_amount}}), payable in equal monthly payments of {{rent_words}} and {{rent_cents}}/100 Dollars (${{rent_amount}}), each in advance of the first day of each month, without demand (hereinafter referred to as the “Monthly Rent” or “Rent”). In the event that the first day of the term is not the first day of a calendar month, Tenant shall pay on the first day of the term a pro rata amount of the Monthly Rent for the period until the end of that month.

{{proration_line}}

SECTION II - SECURITY DEPOSIT

The Tenant, upon execution of this Lease, shall deposit with the Landlord the sum of {{deposit_words}} and {{deposit_cents}}/100 Dollars (${{deposit_amount}}) as a security deposit. The Landlord acknowledges receipt from the Tenant of payment of the security deposit and the Tenant is hereby advised of their rights with respect to the State of Maryland laws concerning security deposits.

The security deposit, or any portion thereof, may be withheld for unpaid rent, damage due to breach of lease or for damage to the leased premises by the Tenant, his family, agents, employees, or social guests in excess of ordinary wear and tear. The Tenant has the right to be present when the Landlord or his agent, inspects the premises in order to determine if any damage was done to the premises, if the Tenant notifies the Landlord by certified mail of his intention to move, the date of moving, and his new address. The notice to be furnished by the Tenant to the Landlord shall be mailed at least thirty (30) days prior to the date of moving. Upon receipt of the notice, the Landlord shall notify the Tenant by certified mail of the time and date when the premises are to be inspected. The date of inspection shall occur within five (5) days before or five (5) days after the date of moving as designated by the Tenant's notice.

The security deposit is not liquidated damages and may not be forfeited to the Landlord for breach of the rental agreement, except in the amount the Landlord is actually damaged by the breach.

In calculating damages for lost future rents, any amount of rents received by Landlord for the premises during the remainder, if any, of the Tenant's term, shall reduce the damages by a like amount.

The Landlord shall return within forty-five (45) days after the end of the tenancy, the security deposit to the Tenant, less any damages rightfully withheld.

Landlord can withhold the security deposit or any portion of it for damages due to breach of lease, or damage to the leased premises by the Tenant, his family, agents, employees, or social guests in excess of ordinary wear and tear.

If any portion of the security deposit is withheld, the Landlord must present by first-class mail directed to the last-known address of the Tenant within forty-five (45) days after the termination of the tenancy, a written list of the damages claimed in the above paragraph, together with a statement of the cost actually incurred.

The amount of the security deposit shall not exceed the equivalent of two (2) months' Rent, or $50.00, whichever is greater, per dwelling unit leased under the Lease. Within thirty (30) days after receipt of the security deposit, Landlord shall deposit it in an escrow account devoted exclusively to security deposits in a banking or savings institution, as required by law.

Landlord need not notify Tenant of Landlord's intention to withhold all or any part of the security deposit if Tenant has been evicted or ejected for breach of a condition or covenant of the Lease prior to the termination of the tenancy or if Tenant has abandoned the Premises prior to the termination of the tenancy. In such event, Tenant may make demand for return of the security deposit by giving written notice by first-class mail to Landlord within forty-five (45) days of being evicted or ejected or of abandoning the Premises. The notice shall specify Tenant's forwarding address. Landlord then, within thirty (30) days of receipt of said notice, shall supply Tenant with a list of damages and costs, by first-class mail.
  Return by Electronic Payment. Tenant authorizes Landlord to return the security deposit, together with any interest required by law and less any amounts lawfully withheld, by electronic payment to the account or payment address designated by Tenant in writing, including Zelle, ACH, or other electronic transfer, in lieu of a mailed check. An electronic payment initiated to Tenant's designated account within forty-five (45) days after the end of the tenancy, and not rejected or returned, satisfies Landlord's obligation to return the deposit. Tenant shall provide the designated payment information together with a forwarding address in writing at least thirty (30) days before the end of the tenancy and shall promptly notify Landlord of any change. If Tenant fails to provide valid payment information, or if an electronic payment is rejected or returned, Landlord shall instead mail a check to Tenant's last known address. Nothing in this paragraph alters Landlord's obligation under Md. Code, Real Prop. § 8-203 to send by first-class mail any written list of damages claimed and statement of costs actually incurred; Landlord may also send a courtesy copy to Tenant's designated email address.

SECTION III - LATE CHARGES

Tenant covenants to pay promptly the Rent as herein provided when due without any deduction, set-off, recoupment, or counterclaim whatsoever. If the Rent is not paid by the 5th day of the month, it shall be deemed late, and Tenant will pay as additional Rent in a sum equal to five percent (5.00%) of the amount of delinquent Rent due which is equal to {{late_words}} (${{late_amount}}). If the Tenant remits the Rent to the Landlord with a check that is not honored by the Landlord’s financial institution, the Tenant shall be responsible for all fees incurred by the Landlord from the Landlord’s financial institution.

SECTION IV - UTILITIES

Landlord will pay when due all charges for {{landlord_utilities}} used on the Premises during the term of this Lease, or any renewal thereof. It is the responsibility of the Tenant to pay the {{tenant_utilities}}, cable bill (if applicable) and any and all other services the Tenant would use, including, but not limited to: internet services, and any and all other services not identified as the Landlord’s responsibility in this section of the Lease, immediately on presentation of these bills when issued by the water department or other governmental agency, as additional Rent. In the event Tenant fails to pay any utility bill for which they are responsible including internet etc within fifteen (15) days of receipt of said bill, then Tenant shall be deemed in default under the terms of this Lease, and the amount thereof may, at the discretion of the Landlord, be added to and deemed part of the Rent due, and Landlord shall have the same remedies for the collection of such charges as for collection of Rent.

SECTION V - PROPER USE OF PREMISES

Tenant covenants to use the Premises for residential purposes only, to keep the Premises clean and safe, to use all equipment and facilities in the Premises in a proper manner, and that Tenant will not deliberately or negligently waste or damage the Premises or knowingly allow any person to do so. If Tenant or any guest or invitee wastes or damages the Premises, Tenant shall promptly pay Landlord the costs of the necessary repairs. Tenant shall permit no more than four (4) persons to reside in the Premises at any one time.

Additionally, Tenant agrees as follows:

A. Tenant shall keep that part of the Premises which he occupies and uses clean and sanitary.

B. Tenant shall dispose from the Premises rubbish, garbage, and other organic and flammable waste in a clean and sanitary manner and shall place rubbish only in those trash receptacles designated by Landlord.

C. Tenant shall keep all plumbing fixtures as clean and sanitary as their condition permits.

D. Tenant shall properly use and operate all electrical and plumbing fixtures.

E. Tenant shall prevent any person on the Premises with their permission from willfully or wantonly destroying, defacing, damaging, impairing, or removing any part of the Premises or the facilities, equipment or appurtenances hereto, nor themself do any such thing.

F. Tenant shall refrain from interfering with the rights of other tenants to peacefully enjoy the use and occupancy of the Premises and shall not conduct or permit to be conducted, vocal or instrumental practice or instruction, radio, television, or stereo capable of being heard outside of the Premises at any time.

G. Tenant shall give Landlord prompt written notice of any accident, dangerous condition or defect occurring on the Premises.

H. Tenant shall not have any waterbeds or water-filled furniture on the Premises.

I. Tenant shall, at its own cost and expense, replace all fuses and lightbulbs in the Premises.

J. Tenant will not change the keys or locks nor add any locks to any door of the Premises.

K. Tenant will not make any alterations or additions to the structure, equipment or fixtures of the Premises or do any redecorating or repainting without the prior written consent of the Landlord.

L. There shall be no smoking in the Premises.

M. The Tenant shall not keep, or cause to keep, any property or material that is classified as Hazardous.

SECTION VI - COMPLIANCE WITH LAWS, RULES AND INSURANCE

Tenant covenants to comply with any applicable laws, regulations, and guidelines of any governmental authority and condominium association and in particular those with respect to the regulation and conservation of fuels, and to comply with all reasonable rules and regulations adopted by the Landlord. Tenant agrees that it will not do, or permit to be done, anything on said Premises to impair or contravene the policy or policies of insurance on said Premises or which will prevent the Landlord from obtaining insurance in companies acceptable to the Landlord, or which will cause the premium rating of the Premises to be increased.
    Tenant shall, at Tenant's expense, obtain and maintain throughout the term of this Lease and any renewal a renter's insurance policy providing personal liability coverage of not less than $100,000 per occurrence and coverage for Tenant's personal property. Tenant shall name Landlord as an interested party, shall provide Landlord proof of coverage prior to occupancy and upon request, and shall not permit the policy to lapse. Failure to maintain such coverage shall constitute a default under this Lease.

SECTION VII - NO ASSIGNMENT OR SUBLEASE

Tenant agrees that this Lease shall not be assigned in whole or in part nor shall all or any portion of the Premises be sublet without first obtaining the written consent of the Landlord. This prohibition includes assignment or subletting by operation of law or otherwise.

SECTION VIII - DELIVERY OF PREMISES

Landlord shall deliver the Premises to Tenant at the beginning of the term of this Lease in a condition permitting habitation with reasonable safety. Landlord also includes with the Premises a Warranty of Habitability in compliance with Federal, State, County and Municipal law.

SECTION IX - MAINTENANCE

Tenant acknowledges that they shall keep the lawns, hedges, flower beds, and shrubbery of the Premises in good order; remove snow and ice from walkways and driveways; keep the Premises in a clean and sanitary condition; and comply with all laws and health and police regulations with respect to the Premises. Tenant shall indemnify and save Landlord harmless from all liability arising out of any violation by Tenant of such laws or regulations or arising out of any neglect or any violation or non-performance by the Tenant of any of the covenants contained in this Lease.
    Tenant shall be responsible for pest and vermin control at the Premises during the term of this Lease, including the cost of routine extermination, and shall promptly report any infestation to Landlord. Landlord shall deliver the Premises free of infestation and shall remain responsible for treatment of any infestation existing at the commencement of the term, caused by a structural defect or condition of the building, or required to be remedied by applicable law, code, or housing quality standards.

SECTION X - REPAIRS

Tenant shall promptly repair, at their own expense, any damage to the Premises which may occur by reasons of their own negligence or the negligence of any member of their family, invites, or guests and all damage caused by pet animals owned by the Tenant, members of their family, invites and guests, but shall not be responsible for ordinary wear and tear. The Tenant shall remit to the Landlord the amount of Seventy-Five and 00/100 Dollars ($75.00) for each service call made by the Tenant to the Landlord regarding the Premises.

SECTION XI - PETS

No pets shall be brought on the Premises without the prior written consent of the Landlord. Violation of this provision shall constitute a breach of the terms and conditions of this Lease. If the Tenant is blind it appears that Landlord must allow the Tenant to keep a seeing-eye dog.

SECTION XII - EXISTING DAMAGES

Landlord shall provide Tenant with a written list of all existing damages to the Premises if Tenant requests this list in writing within fifteen (15) days after Tenant occupies the Premises.

SECTION XIII – MILITARY RELOCATION

In the event the Tenant is, or hereafter becomes, a member of the United States Armed Forces on extended active duty and hereafter the Tenant receives permanent change of station orders to depart from the area where the Premises are located, or is relieved from active duty, retires or separates from the military, or is ordered into military housing, then in any of these events, the Tenant may terminate this lease upon giving thirty (30) days written notice to the Landlord. The Tenant shall also provide to the Landlord a copy of the official orders or a letter signed by the tenant's commanding officer, reflecting the change, which warrants termination under this clause. The Tenant will pay prorated rent for any days (he/she) occupy the dwelling past the first day of the month. The damage/security deposit will be promptly returned to the tenant, provided there are no damages to the premises.

SECTION XIV - LANDLORD'S ACCESS

Landlord and Landlord's agents shall have the right to enter upon the Premises at all reasonable times for the purpose of inspection or making any repairs which Landlord may be required to make by reason of other provisions of this Lease or by reason of the requirements of public authorities. For a period of ninety (90) days prior to the expiration of the term of this Lease, or any renewal thereof, Landlord shall have the right, at reasonable times, to show prospective tenants or purchasers the Premises and to post "For Sale" or "For Rent" signs thereon, if not prohibited by law.

SECTION XV - TENANT'S PERSONAL PROPERTY

Neither Landlord nor its agents, contractors, or subcontractors or its or their present or future controlling persons, directors, officers, agents, or employees shall be responsible for any loss or damage to any personal property of Tenant placed on, in, or about the Premises, or for any personal injury to Tenant or Tenant's family or each of their agents, employees, invitees, or contractors unless such loss or damage is caused by the negligence or willful misconduct of Landlord or its contractors or subcontractors or its or their present and future controlling persons, directors, officers, agents, or employees. Landlord shall not be deemed a bailee as to any personal property placed on, in, or about the Premises, and Tenant agrees to pay, as additional rent, all reasonable costs incurred by Landlord in removing and storing any of Tenant's personal property remaining at the Premises following the termination of this Lease. Waterbeds are not permitted to be installed or used on the Premises.

SECTION XVI - ALTERATIONS

Tenant has no authority to make any alterations to the Premises, or to incur any debt, or make any charge against the Landlord, or create any lien upon the Premises for any work done or materials furnished without the express consent of the Landlord in writing. Any television aerial or other fixtures installed by the Tenant shall be at his own expense, shall be affixed in a manner which will not damage the Premises, and shall be removed by the Tenant at the expiration of the Lease. In the event such aerial or other fixtures or other personal property of the Tenant is not removed at the expiration of the Lease, the Landlord may treat the same as abandoned and charge the Tenant the cost actually paid for removal.

SECTION XVII - END OF TERM

Tenant shall deliver up and surrender to Landlord possession of the Premises upon the expiration or earlier termination of the Lease Term, broom clean, free of debris and Tenant's personal property, in good order, condition and state of repair, ordinary wear and tear excepted, and shall deliver the keys at the offices of Landlord. Any property of Tenant not promptly removed shall be deemed to have been abandoned by Tenant and to have become the property of Landlord and may be retained by Landlord or disposed of at Tenant’s expense (Tenant agreeing to remain liable for the cost thereof even though this Lease shall have been terminated) as Landlord shall desire. In the event that the Tenant holds over after the expiration of the Lease Term with the consent of Landlord, such tenancy shall be for a month-to-month only and shall not be a renewal hereof and Tenant shall comply with all the terms, covenants and conditions set forth in this Lease insofar as the same are applied to a month-to-month tenancy. In the event that Tenant remains in possession of the Premises after the expiration of the term of this Lease without the consent of Landlord and shall fail to vacate the Premises after the expiration or sooner termination of this Lease, Tenant understands and agrees that Tenant shall be deemed to be occupying said Demised Premises as a tenant from month to month, subject to all of the terms, covenants and conditions set forth in this Lease insofar as the same are applied to a month to month tenancy, except that the then current Monthly Rent may increase by fifteen percent (15%). If the Premises are not surrendered at the end of the Lease, Tenant shall be additionally responsible to Landlord for all damage (including but not limited to the loss of Rent) which Landlord shall suffer by reason thereof, and Tenant hereby indemnifies Landlord against all claims made by any succeeding tenant against Landlord, resulting from delay by Landlord in delivering possession of Premises to such succeeding tenant. Tenant's obligation to observe or perform all of the terms, covenants, conditions, provisions, and agreements of this Paragraph shall survive the expiration or other termination of this Lease.

SECTION XVIII - DESTRUCTION OF PREMISES

If the Premises is rendered totally unfit for occupancy by fire, tempest, or other act of God, or by the acts of rioters or public enemies, or other unavoidable accident, the tenancy hereby created shall immediately cease upon the payment of the Rent apportioned to the time of such happening. If, however, the Premises is only partially destroyed or damaged and Landlord decides to repair the damage, then such repairs shall be made by Landlord without unreasonable delay, Rent shall abate, and this Lease shall remain in full force and effect.

SECTION XIX - BREACH AND REMEDIES

If Tenant breaches this Lease, Landlord may repossess the Premises pursuant to judicial process, and Landlord shall have other rights as may be allowed by law.

Tenant will pay the court costs charged to Landlord for notice sent for non-payment of rent, and Tenant also agrees to reimburse Landlord for all reasonable expenses incurred by Landlord, including attorney's fees as additional Rent, if ejectment is ordered by the Court.

SECTION XX - WAIVER

Any waiver of any covenant or condition of this Lease shall extend to the particular case only, and only in the manner specified, and shall not be construed as applying to or in any way waiving any further or other rights hereunder. The exercise of any of the options aforesaid shall not be construed as a waiver of Landlord's right to recover actual damages for any breach in an action at law, or to restrain any breach or threatened breach in equity or otherwise. Acceptance of Rent with knowledge of default shall not be a waiver of that default.

No payment by Tenant or receipt by Landlord of a lesser amount than any payment of Rent herein stipulated shall be deemed to be other than on account of the earliest Rent due and payable, nor shall any endorsement or statement on any check or any letter accompanying any check or payment as Rent be deemed an accord and satisfaction. Landlord may accept such check or payment without prejudice to Landlord's right to recover the balance of such Rent or pursue any other remedy provided in this Lease, at law or in equity.

SECTION XXI - INDEMNIFICATION

Except to the extent specifically limited by law, Tenant shall indemnify and save harmless Landlord and its contractors and subcontractors and its or their present and future controlling persons, directors, officers, agent, and employees from and against any and all claims, actions, damages, liability and/or expense in connection with loss of life, personal injury and/or damage to property arising from or out of the condition of the Premises or because of the occupancy or use by Tenant of the Premises or any part thereof or any other part of Landlord's property, or occasioned wholly or in part by any act or omission of Tenant or Tenant's family or each of their agents, employees, invitees, or contractors or any other person on the Premises during the term of this Lease, excepting the Landlord’s failure to repair.

SECTION XXII - REPRESENTATIONS BY TENANT IN APPLICATION

Tenant warrants that all information provided by him in the application as attached to and made a part of for the Premises are true and correct and that any misrepresentations shall constitute a breach of this Lease and shall afford the Landlord all remedies under this Lease.

Tenant represents and warrants that: (i) Tenant and each person or entity owning an interest in Tenant is (x) not currently identified on the Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List maintained by the Office of Foreign Assets Control, Department of the Treasury (“OFAC”) and/or on any other similar list maintained by OFAC pursuant to any authorizing statute, executive order or regulation (collectively, the “List”) and (y) not a person or entity with whom a citizen of the United States is prohibited to engage in transactions by any trade embargo, economic sanction, or other prohibition of United States law, regulation, or Executive Order of the President of the United States; (ii) none of the funds or other assets of Tenant constitute property of, or are beneficially owned, directly or indirectly, by any Embargoed Person (as hereinafter defined); (iii) no Embargoed Person has any interest of any nature whatsoever in Tenant (whether directly or indirectly); (iv) none of the funds of Tenant have been derived from any unlawful activity with the result that the investment in Tenant is prohibited by law or that the Lease is in violation of law; and (v) Tenant has implemented procedures, and will consistently apply those procedures, to ensure the foregoing representations and warranties remain true and correct at all times. The term “Embargoed Person” means any person, entity or government subject to trade restrictions under U.S. law, including but not limited to, the International Emergency Economic Powers Act, 50 U.S.C. §1701 et seq., The Trading with the Enemy Act, 50 U.S.C. App. 1 et seq., and any Executive Orders or regulations promulgated thereunder with the result that the investment in Tenant is prohibited by law or Tenant is in violation of law
    Tenant represents that, as of the date of this Lease, no Tenant or other occupant of the Premises is a member of the United States Armed Forces on active duty, a dependent of such a member, or has been called to active duty, except as disclosed in writing to Landlord. Tenant shall notify Landlord in writing within fifteen (15) days if any Tenant or occupant enters active military service during the term of this Lease or any renewal. Nothing in this paragraph waives or limits any right of Tenant under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act, 50 U.S.C. § 3901 et seq., and Section XIII of this Lease remains in full effect.

SECTION XXIII - BANKRUPTCY OF TENANT

It is further understood and agreed that in the event Tenant is adjudicated as bankrupt or makes an assignment for the benefit of his creditors and cannot meet obligation under this Lease, this agreement shall, at the option of the Landlord, cease and terminate. Said Premises shall be surrendered to Landlord who hereby reserves the right, in either of said events, to forthwith re-enter and repossess said Premises.

SECTION XXIV - ENTIRE AGREEMENT

The Lease, when executed, contains the entire agreement between the parties hereto, and neither party shall be bound by any oral statements or representations by way of inducement or otherwise not herein contained and cannot be changed except in writing execute by all parties hereto.

SECTION XXV - GOVERNING LAW

This Lease shall be governed by the laws of the jurisdiction where the leased Premises are located. To the extent that any provisions hereof may violate any such governing law, the violating provision will be null and void but will not invalidate this Lease, and this Lease shall be deemed to be amended by operation of law to comply with mandatory provisions of State, County or local statutes or ordinances validly enacted and in force in the jurisdiction in which the Premises are located.

SECTION XXVI - AUTOMATIC RENEWAL PROVISION

Unless either Landlord or Tenant gives the other written notice at least thirty (30) days prior to the end of the Lease that such party does not wish to continue the Lease for a term of the same length, this Lease will automatically renew on the same terms, covenants, and conditions. Said automatic renewal of the Lease shall run from month-to-month.

SECTION XXVII - Landlord’s Termination Option

Landlord shall have the option to terminate and cancel the Lease (“Landlord’s Termination Option”) by delivering to Tenant written notice of Landlord’s exercise of Landlord’s Termination Option (the “Termination Notice”). The Amended Lease shall terminate effective as of the date that is sixty (60) days after Landlord’s delivery to Tenant of the Termination Notice (the “Termination Date”), and Tenant shall surrender the Premises to Landlord on or before the Termination Date in accordance with Article 17 of the Lease. If Landlord exercises Landlord’s Termination Option, and Tenant timely and properly surrenders the Premises to Landlord on or before the Termination Date, Tenant shall not be obligated to pay the monthly installments of Rent that are due after the Termination Date

SECTION XXVIII - ACKNOWLEDGEMENT OF TERMS OF LEASE

Tenant hereby acknowledges that they have read this Lease agreement, understand each and every provision herein contained, or have sought the advice of counsel with respect to this Lease agreement or any provisions therein contained, not so understood by them.

SECTION XXIX – ELECTRONIC COMMUNICATIONS AND SIGNATURES

The parties consent to electronic signatures and electronic delivery of communications under this Lease, as permitted by the federal E-SIGN Act and the Maryland Uniform Electronic Transactions Act. An electronic signature has the same effect as an original signature.

For purposes of this Section, each party's designated electronic address is the email address that party most recently provided to the other in writing, and for Tenant, initially the email address and mobile number stated in Tenant's rental application. Each party shall notify the other in writing within five (5) days of any change to its email address, mobile number, or mailing address, and Tenant shall keep the designated email account active throughout the term.

Any notice, bill, receipt, or other document under this Lease may be sent by email to the designated address and is deemed delivered on the date sent, unless the sender receives an undeliverable response. Landlord may instead post a document to a tenant portal and email Tenant that it is available. This paragraph does not apply where law requires a specific method of delivery, including the security deposit damages list under Section II and any notice to quit or terminate, or to court papers.

Tenant consents to receive text messages from Landlord regarding maintenance, access, and account matters. Text messages do not constitute legal notice, and Tenant may withdraw this consent or consent to electronic delivery in writing at any time.

SECTION XXX – RULES AND REGULATIONS

The following Rules and Regulations have been established by management and are considered and addendum to the Lease Agreement. Failure to comply with said Rules and Regulation may, at the discretion of the Owner/Manager, be grounds for termination of the Lease Agreement.

  • MAINTENANCE REQUESTS: In case of emergency, please call 703-957-9615. Emergencies include fire (call 911 first), flood, electrical shortage, and sewer backups. Maintenance requests will be scheduled within a two hour window. If you are unavailable during that time, maintenance personnel are authorized to enter the unit and perform the repair.

  • PARKING FACILITIES: Parking lots are not to be used for abandoned or inoperable vehicles. The determination of whether a vehicle is abandoned or inoperable shall be within the discretion of the Owner/Manager, but a vehicle will be deemed to be inoperable if not "street legal". Automobiles shall not be parked on the grass. Recreational vehicles and trailers are not permitted on site as per the Governing HOA Documents. Vehicles not conforming to these rules may be towed away at Resident's expense. Automobile repairs will not be permitted anywhere on property.

  • MOWING AND GROUNDS UPKEEP: You are responsible for the grass please keep it mowed and weeded at all times. We maintain a high degree of grounds maintenance. Management requests the Resident(s) help in maintaining high standards. In communities with common areas planting in common areas is prohibited. Non-compliance is a breach of the Lease and could result in termination.

  • STORAGE: Items are not to be stored in the front of your property. All items should be stored in the garage or neatly kept on the deck or patio. Pools of any kind are not allowed. No goods or materials of any kind which are combustible or would increase Pre risk should be placed in storage areas. Storage in such areas shall be at the Resident's risk and Owner/Manager shall not be responsible for any loss or damages.

  • SUPERVISION OF MINORS: All children 10 and under must be under the supervision of a parent or guardian when engaging in outdoor activities.

  • PLUMBING: A charge will be made for unclogging plumbing equipment, in cases where malfunctions are caused by the introduction of improper objects therein, such as toys, cloth objects, grease or other foreign matter. The cost of repair or replacement of other equipment or plumbing will be paid by Resident(s).

  • ANTENNAS: Radio, television or other types of antennas should not be placed or erected by Resident(s) on the roof or attached to the exterior of the building.

  • DISTURBING NOISES: Said townhome is Resident's home, free from interruption by Owner/Manager unless Resident or Resident's guests disturb other residents of the Community. Resident, family and guests shall not at any time make any noise, or do anything to conduct themselves in any way which disturbs any other Resident or interferes with the rights, comforts or conveniences of any other resident. Televisions, stereo units, radios and musical instruments are not to be played at such volume or time that will annoy persons in other homes. Such noises shall be inaudible outside the home between 11:00pm and 10:00am. the following morning.

  • SIGNS: Resident(s) should not display any signs, exterior lights or markings on the home. Nothing may be placed between the blinds and window that is visible from the sidewalk. Do not attach awnings or other projections to the outside of the building of which the home is a part.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties hereto have signed and sealed this Lease the date and year first above written.
